title: P15.9-B5.3: /app/missions* Mission Operations + Task Entry + Mission Detail (canonical reads)
description: P15.9-B5.3 — Mission Operations & Task Entry modern port. /app/missions: global unfiltered mission list (labeled, never business-scoped) + search/filter by runtime_state + sort + routing card (unavailable disclosed, never zero) + deep links. /app/missions/new: verified project select (raw-array, malformed blocks) -> POST /api/missions/preview persisted plan -> pinned {preview_id, plan_digest} ConfirmDialog -> ONE seam POST /api/missions/confirm -> detail nav; input edits invalidate preview; invalid/empty plan rejected; ambiguous outcomes honest, no auto-retry; auto-confirm opt-in only. /app/missions/:id: identity-verified detail + independently-settled DAG/tasks/executions/timeline/evidence/files sections with element validation; read-only file viewer honoring truncation; pending-approval links to /app/inbox; lifecycle pause/resume/cancel/acknowledge via pinned ConfirmDialog + canonical refetch; bound_open_id backlink to /app/objectives only. ObjectiveDetail mission links moved to /app/missions/:id. UI-only; no backend/schema/dependency changes; no Planner/Router/Gate/Executor redesign.
